title: Composition preserves the local Hoelder class C^{m,alpha}_loc
statement: Let E1, E2, E3 be real normed spaces, m in N, 0 < alpha <= 1, U in E1 and V in E2 open, f : E1 -> E2 with f(U) contained in V, h : E2 -> E3, and assume 1 <= m or f is C^1 on U or h is C^1 on V. If f is C^m on U with D^m f alpha-Hoelder on every compact subset of U, and h is C^m on V with D^m h alpha-Hoelder on every compact subset of V, then h o f is C^m on U and D^m(h o f) is alpha-Hoelder on every compact subset of U (D^j = iteratedFDeriv R j).
lean_statement: ∀ (E₁ E₂ E₃ : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E₁] [NormedSpace ℝ E₁] [NormedAddCommGroup E₂] [NormedSpace ℝ E₂] [NormedAddCommGroup E₃] [NormedSpace ℝ E₃] (m : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (f : E₁ → E₂) (h : E₂ → E₃) (U : Set E₁) (V : Set E₂), 0 < α → α ≤ 1 → IsOpen U → IsOpen V → MapsTo f U V → (1 ≤ m ∨ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f U ∨ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 h V) → ContDiffOn ℝ m f U → (∀ K : Set E₁, IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → ContDiffOn ℝ m h V → (∀ K : Set E₂, IsCompact K → K ⊆ V → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m h x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m h y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → ContDiffOn ℝ m (h ∘ f) U ∧ ∀ K : Set E₁, IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (h ∘ f) x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (h ∘ f) y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α
